predecessor.s7_result: NULL_OR_NEGATIVE for incremental online TTT superiority; absolute retrieval with 128 updates demonstrated

hypothesis: With fully matched training episodes and 512 optimizer steps, will the original official nonfused Mamba2+TTT hybrid generalize fresh key-value bindings, and will online TTT fast-weight updates outperform the parameter-identical static TTT-disabled model? Compare both with the fully trained explicit-retrieval conventional positive control from the exact same input information.

arms.type: original official Mamba2 nonfused, causal attention, TTTLinear, fixed depth
same native hybrid, all same model params and initialization as online

data.heldout_generator: same S6 get_batch but new unseen seed*10000000 + 9800000 + batch_index*17
data.native_encoding: four alternating support key and value tokens (8 total) followed by eight query key tokens (16 total) with original S1 marker channels 32,33,34; same information as conventional structured support tensors

controls: exact pinned original G7-S6 generator/model blob (not reimplemented)
no duplicates among keys in each episode
conventional must learn task and degrade under support corruption
fresh heldout batch seeds not used by preceding S6/S7 studies
within online/static native pair same initial weight hash, optimizer updates, input examples and parameters
native per-seed cold restore and no update during evaluation
conventional trained from scratch in the same run; do not reuse an earlier checkpoint
process-local exact signed Python 3.12 .16 headers and CUDA link only; no installs

methodology.caveat: Conventional has explicit retrieval inductive bias and 1,025 parameters; native has 90,259 parameters and different CPU/GPU cost. This is matched data/exposure against a strong conventional positive control, NOT equal-compute or parameter-matched proof of hybrid architectural superiority.

stop_conditions: source or upstream blob SHA drift
missing signed exact Python dev headers
GPU >1GiB allocated or free <4GiB at start
wrong number of optimizer updates or training episodes
reporting: Always report failure/null outcomes and actual CPU/GPU time, allocation, episode counts, seeds, baseline and negative controls; do not claim token-free native reasoning or superiority from this isolated synthetic task.
